drawer.type: layer surface left-margin animation, 7ms timer (matched to the 144 Hz output)
drawer.note: The surface stays mapped and parked with one 1px border at alpha 0.004 on screen: a fully off-screen layer is not composited, and the first show would paint at the open position. The near-transparent pixel keeps the buffer warm while being invisible. Each 7ms step advances elapsed time with a cap, so a stall pauses the drawer instead of skipping it. The compositor translates the already-rendered buffer; glyphs/shadow are not re-rasterized. Hidden state disables input targeting.

motion.page_transition_note: Baseline Gtk.Stack SLIDE_LEFT_RIGHT under the default GL renderer: 31 frames / ~215 ms at 144 fps.

notes: RSS is dominated by shared GTK/GL pages: Pss is the meaningful figure.
A bare GJS + GTK4 window already costs ~182 MiB RSS, so the sidebar UI adds ~30 MiB RSS / ~50 MiB private.
Switching to the cairo renderer would drop shared pages but cap page transitions at 48-72fps; rejected.
